LESSON: GROWTH OF TIMBER TREES

Grade: SNE  /  physical-impairment / Grade 10
Subject: WOODWORK
Strand: Materials
Topic 2.1: Growth of timber trees
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 12

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Growth of timber trees, part of Materials in SNE  /  physical-impairment / Grade 10 WOODWORK.

Key inquiry question: Why is the growing of timber trees important in society? 2. How do we grow trees for timber production?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

A. Suggested learning experiences (from KICD)

1. brainstorm on the process of timber tree growth from seed to maturity. Learners with speech difficulties could use residual speech as they are lip read by peers, learner support assistant or teacher, they could also sign, use total communication or write about the process of timber growth from seed to maturity,

2. discuss in purposive groups dangers of growing trees near the road, 1.

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1. brainstorm on the process of timber tree growth from seed to maturity. Learners with speech difficulties could use residual speech as they are lip read by peers, learner support assistant or teacher, they could also sign, use total communication or write about the process of timber growth from seed to maturity,
2. discuss in purposive groups dangers of growing trees near the road, 1.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Growth of timber trees together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
15

• Communication and collaboration: learner develops speaking, listening and teamwork skills when

brainstorming on the process of timber tree growth from seed to maturity

• Critical thinking and problem solving: learner develops evaluation and decision making skills when sketching

and labelling parts of a tree trunk

• Learning to learn: learner reflects on own work when preparing a tree nursery within the school compound.

Values:
● Responsibility: learner takes care of the tree nurseries within the school compound and monitors their growth.

● Patriotism: learner donates seedlings for environmental conservation.

● Unity: learner takes a walk to the surrounding to observe and classify trees into softwoods or hardwoods.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs):

● Social cohesion: learners tour and interact with their neighbourhood to observe and classify trees.

● Environmental conservation: learners prepare a tree nursery within the school compound and monitor their

growth.

● Road safety: safety awareness on dangers of growing trees near the road.

Suggested learning resources: adapted digital devices such as laptops, computers, tablets, photos, and learner

support assistant.
